text:
maria: Quick check — vendor (VenaCloud) quoted delivery of 8x A100s for eu-west; procurement noted ETA 'end of week' but no serials or shipping info yet. Anyone tracked final confirmation?

sam: I asked them 30m ago, waiting on the logistics team. Do we have the PO number to prod to them?

maria: PO-9482. I pasted the PO and the contact in the procurement ticket, but no reply yet.

infra-bot: Ticket created: PR-2345 assigned to @sam. Status: awaiting vendor confirmation.

raj: Heads up — vendor support just messaged me privately: one rack has a firmware mismatch flagged during burn-in. They said it could delay shipping by 48–72h while they re-flash and re-test.

gina: Can we short-circuit with a mixed delivery? e.g., 4x A100 now + 4x H100 later? Would that work for the ded-pool sizing until all A100s arrive?

maria: That's an option if the serving runtime supports mixed-model pools; we need to confirm quantization/perf expectations. Also we still need a cloud quota bump request opened for the new reserved instances. Who can take that?

lisa: I can open the quota request with cloud now. Which machine types should I request? Also specify whether it's regional or zonal.

sam: Request these flavors (region eu-west1, regional): `a2-highgpu-8g` x2, `a2-highgpu-16g` x2 as temporary; final planned: 8x `a2-megagpu-16g` equivalent A100s. If vendor offers H100s instead, note down `a2-megagpu-16g` vs `h1-megagpu` mapping in the request.

maria: Thanks. @lisa please add PO-9482 and note potential +3d firmware delay. Add a fallback line: "If firmware delay > 48h, accept mixed A100/H100 shipment."

lisa: Will do. Opening quota ticket now -> https://console.cloud/quotas/req/12345 (I'll paste full request once done).

raj: Also, timeline for canary smoke test — if we get 4 GPUs earlier, can eng-runtime run a partial canary this sprint? We need to validate kernel selection and quantization paths.

gina: Yes, we can run a 4-GPU smoke with reduced batch sizes. I'll coordinate with runtime team. Ping me when infra confirms serials.

maria: Final ask: if vendor confirms firmware fix today, we proceed. If not, we accept mixed shipment and run partial canary. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
